name: auto-code-review
description: Chief Wiggum style high-signal review of repository changes.

entrypoints.title: Review uncommitted changes
entrypoints.description: Run a read-only code review over a workspace git diff.

diff_command.description: Read-only command that prints the review diff.

parameters.name: review_focus
parameters.description: Extra areas to prioritize during review.

parameters.name: severity_floor
parameters.description: Minimum severity to report: BLOCKER, CRITICAL, MAJOR, or MINOR.

constraints: Read-only review; do not edit, stage, commit, reset, or clean files.
Report only high-confidence issues with file and line references.
success_criteria: The result includes PASS, FIX, or FAIL.
Findings are ordered by severity and cite actionable locations.
The RESULT artifact is valid JSON matching the declared schema.
